task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an exciting round of TextWorld? You do! Your first objective is to venture west. With that over with, lift the keycard from the floor of the workshop. If you can get your hands on the keycard, make an effort to venture east. Then, take a trip north. Okay, and then, assure that the box is unlocked with the keycard. Then, ensure that the box is open. Then, retrieve the passkey from the box. And then, go to the south. After that, unlock the hatch. After unlocking the hatch, open the hatch inside the bedchamber. And then, go to the east. With that done, retrieve the TextWorld keycard from the floor of the closet. And then, check that the TextWorld portal within the closet is unlocked with the TextWorld keycard. Then, assure that the TextWorld portal in the closet is ajar. And then, try to travel south. That done, move east. Then, attempt to head east. If you can accomplish that, recover the latchkey from the armchair. Alright, thanks!
description:
You find yourself in a bedchamber. A normal one.

thought: I should go west to start the sequence of actions.

There is an unblocked exit to the east.

There is a keycard on the floor.
